title: FEMA reimbursement of county wildfire response costs
summary: The fire department reported its first two FEMA reimbursement checks, totaling over $890,000, which pass through the state emergency agency. Police said FEMA repaid all fire-related overtime and a good portion of other costs, but some equipment requests missed the repayment deadline.

timeline.text: FEMA gives the money to the state emergency agency, which then passes it to the county.
The county got its first two FEMA reimbursement checks, totaling over $890,000 for fire department projects.
The deputy chief said all police overtime from the fires was reimbursed.
The deputy chief said some equipment requests did not meet the deadline for repayment.
The police department said FEMA has repaid a good portion of its fire costs, but not all of them.
